name: engineering-audit-haljordan-muaddib
description: Comprehensive, read-only engineering audit of a repository that produces an evidence-based Markdown report — prioritized findings with severity, confidence, verified file:line citations, failure scenarios and fixes; architecture map; strengths to keep; impact-vs-effort roadmap; coverage summary. Optional modules audit agent/skill configuration (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .claude/, .agents/) and design a collaboration workflow between the owner and several coding agents. Use it whenever the user asks
